events.title: Sunday Swap Series
events.description: A casual women's meetup in Lancaster to share, connect, and exchange items in a relaxed park setting. Bring up to 12 items you'd like to share with the group. Items can be a mix of categories that fit a seasonal theme or simply be things you enjoy making, collecting, growing, or giving. We'll set everything out, walk around the table together, and take turns choosing items from each other's collections. This is a low-pressure, creative exchange designed to meet new women in Lancaster in a more intentional way than typical networking or sitting-at-a-table events. Ideas: Plants or cuttings Baked goods Home decor Artwork or prints Handmade crafts Small thrifted finds Garden-related items Seasonal favorites Looking forward to seeing both familiar and new faces! *11/25/26 event is at 11AM

events.title: Kindermusik Special Class
events.description: Kindermusik is a globally loved early childhood music-and-movement program focused on experiential learning, process over product, and joyful, community-centered play. Fiona Gillespie is a licensed Kindermusik educator, professional singer and instrumentalist, and longtime advocate for community-centered arts. With 12+ years of teaching experience—from toddlers to college students—she brings warmth, musicality, and a deep understanding of child-led learning. Special offerings: 12/12 Holiday Special Class MUSIC TRANSFORMS THE MIND! Studies show that music activates more areas of the brain than anything else we experience. Adding music to other activities, such as moving, drawing, playing, or reading, enhances a child's whole learning process. Engaging with music doesn't need to exist in isolation! Nurture your child's inborn love of music. Bring music into everyday life. Individual Class Tickets and Bundled Enrollment Registration are both available via the link below.

events.title: West Art Open Mics
events.description: Looking to get some experience playing your music in front of a supportive, listening audience? Are you interested in meeting other local musicians and listening to their hand-crafted songs? If so, come out to West Art's open mic nights! 1st and 3rd Wednesday from 7:00 pm to 9:00 pm - Acoustic Open Mic with local songwriter Andrew Pauls. This open mic will take place in the Art Bar and is focused on acoustic music (i.e., no drum kit or amps). West Art will provide up to three inputs for your instrument and voice. Original songs are encouraged, but cover songs are always welcome! Each performer will have enough time to play 2-3 songs (10-15 minutes). Sign-ups at 6:30 pm! 2nd and 4th Wednesday from 7:00 - 9:00 pm - BLAST OFF Open Mic with Emily Siegrist. (18+ Recommended) Emily Siegrist has been hosting open mics known as BLAST OFF in different locations in Lancaster City since 2013, aiming to build confidence and motivation for local musicians, rappers, poets, and comedians to reach their goals in the performing arts. This open mic is located in the Art Bar and takes place every 2nd and 4th Wednesday. Doors and signups are at 7 pm! This event is recommended for ages 18+ due to possible adult themes. If you come to play, come to listen! Be prepared to be an attentive audience member and support the other performers.

events.title: West Art - Ballroom Dance Classes
events.description: Join us for an evening of music, movement, and connection at our upcoming Social Ballroom Dance! Whether you're stepping onto the dance floor for the very first time or you've been dancing for years, this event is designed for all. Enjoy a relaxed, welcoming atmosphere where you can practice your favorite dances, learn some new moves, meet new people, and have fun. No partner is required—just bring your enthusiasm and comfortable shoes. Come dance, learn, and make memories with us! Doors open at 6:30 pm, with lessons starting at 7 pm! Bring your dancing shoes!

events.title: Latin Dance Night!
events.description: We’re making it official: monthly Latin dance nights are here. Join us for Salsa & Bachata lessons from Luis Santiago, and then DJ Rumspringa will bring back his high-energy mix designed to keep the floor moving all night long. No experience? Perfect. Been waiting for a sign to try Latin dance? This is your sign to do it. Bring a friend, bring your hips, let’s make the room move! What to expect at the show: >> Doors will open at 7:00 PM. >> Tickets are $10 in advance and at the door if not sold out. As always, we’re proud to present an all-ages event! >> Parking is available on the street around F&M College. We suggest finding a spot on the park side of Buchanan Ave, Race Ave, or College Ave (North of Buchanan). Thank you for helping us be good neighbors! >> Format: This will be a standing event in City Hall. Our space is ADA accessible, and we will do our best to accommodate any specific needs. >> If you haven't yet discovered the magic of the West Art Coffee⚡Bar, now's your chance! We're open from 7 am-10 pm daily, with a full and delicious espresso bar menu, along with a lovely selection of beer, wine, and cocktails, plenty of N/A options, and some tasty bites from our favorite local bakeries. Something for everyone, all day long! Come hang out before the show and experience it for yourself! >> Please note that all ticket sales are final. Tickets purchased using digital payment methods include a small service fee. Cash purchases at the door are not subject to this fee. Thank you for supporting great music!

events.title: West Art Presents: The Grateful Allman Band Experience!
events.description: West Art is excited to welcome The Grateful Allman Band Experience (GABE), bringing together the legendary music of The Grateful Dead, The Allman Brothers Band, and The Band—three giants of American rock whose influence continues to resonate across generations. Featuring an all-star lineup drawn from notable Mid-Atlantic touring groups including Danger Bird, Covered with Jam, Montgomery Warlocks, and The Crimestoppers; GABE creates a vibrant, improvisation-driven concert experience inspired by the spirit of the iconic Watkins Glen Summer Jam. Join us!

events.title: West Art and WXPN Welcome Low Cut Connie's New Years Eve Rock N Roll Shindig!
events.description: Get ready for a New Year’s Eve celebration like no other! Low Cut Connie is bringing their electrifying blend of rock ’n’ roll, soul, blues, and good old-fashioned piano-pounding chaos back to West Art, and we couldn't be more excited! Known for their unforgettable live shows and frontman Adam Weiner’s larger-than-life energy, Low Cut Connie turns every room into a party, and there’s no better night to join in than New Year’s Eve! Joining them this year is Lancaster's own Slimfit! Grab your friends, put on your dancing shoes, and raise a glass as we count down to 2027. New year. New memories. Same old West Art chaos!

events.title: West Art Presents: An Afternoon with Goodnight Moonshine feat. Molly Venter of Red Molly, with support from Old Sleepers
events.description: West Art is thrilled to announce that Goodnight Moonshine is taking over Sanctuary! They're no strangers to Lancaster, and they're bringing a captivating blend of folk, jazz, and Americana to West Art! Featuring the soulful vocals of Molly Venter and the inventive guitar work of Eben Pariser, the duo delivers rich harmonies, heartfelt songwriting, and an intimate, genre-bending sound. Opening the night is Olds Sleeper, the solo project of Heath James Hardin, with songs derived from the landscapes and people of rural Pennsylvania. Employing banjo, resonator guitar, acoustic guitar, mandolin and ukelele, Hardin writes songs that challenge stereotypical country and folk styles! Join us for an intimate afternoon of songs and stories under the stained glass!

events.title: West Art Presents: A Wild Kindness - A Tribute To David Berman
events.description: During the week of what would've been his 60th birthday, West Art will be celebrating the legacy of one of America's most distinctive voices, David Berman. The evening will feature an all-star lineup of local and regional musicians, including Jordan and JW of the Nielsen Family Band, Elephant 6's Giant Day, and Cozy Galaxies (with their first performance since 2012), all performing songs from the Silver Jews and Purple Mountains catalogs. Also performing: Super Infinity (Rob Grote of The Districts), Dustin White (American Motors), Ben Roth (Sleepy Limbs / The Kaleidoscope), Raf Diaz (We Were Skeletons), Nate Yeager (The Scouts), Kevin Stairiker (Traffic Nightmare), Jesse Barki (Sun Not Yellow), and Adam Ozimek and Thaddeus Passerieb (Uncle Brothers), and more! Poetry readings by Katie Rineer and Derek Zanetti. Wear a corduroy suit. We'll see you there!

events.title: West Art Presents Vivace Live: Holiday Strings by Candlelight!
events.description: A Candlelit Holiday evening with Vivace Live—where seasonal favorites meet jazz, Celtic melodies, and pop hits. Join us as we welcome Vivace Live back to West Art’s beautiful City Hall for an intimate holiday concert. Performing in the round among the audience, Vivace Live brings the music close, blending Christmas classics with lively jazz, Celtic melodies, and familiar pop favorites to create the warmth of a cozy holiday gathering with friends. With candlelight glowing against the stained glass, it’s the perfect setting for a snowy-evening feeling and a little romantic Christmas magic. Space is limited, and their last concert sold out, so reserve your tickets early. We can’t wait to celebrate the season with you!

events.title: 10 Years of Hot Dad Calendar! With Sun Not Yellow and Sweaty Money!
events.description: Oh man! We're excited to announce that Hot Dad Calendar is hitting their 10 year anniversary, and they're taking over City Hall! Born in Reading, PA, and raised throughout the Central PA/Greater Philadelphia Area, Hot Dad Calendar is the authentic result of three friends combining their distinctive styles and personalities to bring a fresh, nostalgic sound to the alternative/indie rock scene. With heavy tones and even heavier subject matter, this gritty trio embodies the belief that being a Hot Dad is not just about aesthetics or fatherhood; It's about earnestly confronting what makes you who you are... while also being really Hot ;) Joining them are Sun Not Yellow and Sweaty Money, two of the finest rock and rollers around! It's gonna get sweaty, it's gonna be loud, and it's gonna be HOT! Grab your friends, get your tickets, and join us!

events.title: Haley Heynderickx w/ John Roseboro
events.description: Haley Heynderickx makes the kind of music that makes you want to slow down and pay attention. With a voice that is both intimate and captivating, her songs find beauty in the everyday while exploring identity, belonging, nature, and all the uncertainty that comes with being human. We're thrilled to have her taking over our City Hall stage! Tender, thoughtful, and quietly spellbinding, Heynderickx’s live performances create an experience that feels less like a concert and more like stepping into a brand new story. Join us and leave with just a little more room for wonder! Opening the evening is John Roseboro! Based in Brooklyn, New York, Roseboro has cultivated a sound that exists outside conventional genre boundaries—melding Brazilian bossa nova and MPB, indie folk, jazz, soul, alternative rock, and devotional music into what he has described as "post-bossa."

events.title: West Art Welcomes Vinegar Creek Constituency & Makeshift Hammer
events.description: Make way! Vinegar Creek Constituency is coming to town! The Pennsylvania Dutch Country's swashbuckling, pseudo-legendary pioneers of the Amerikindasorta style of string band music is ready to channel the venerable old ghosts of American folk music tradition through imaginative, emotive original songs delivered with rock n roll intensity. Full of shouting, floorboard- stomping soul, their live performances are uplifting, high-energy events with fans dancing in the aisles and clapping, stomping, and singing along! Joining them is Makeshift Hammer (formerly Driftwood Soldier), which makes gutter-folk music, a blend of bittersweet ballads, crooked stories, and thumping blue rants on mandolin, bass guitar, and junk drums, described by WXPN as "a bluesy version of Nick Cave with a nod to Tom Waits!"

events.title: Holiday Dueling Pianos: Festive Favorites & Loud Singalongs!
events.description: We’re thrilled to bring Dueling Pianos back to West Art for a special holiday celebration! Featuring two pianos, fearless pianists, and a room full of people calling the shots, this high-energy, wildly interactive show is led by Love Me Duel—Mary and Devin Calderin, a husband-and-wife duo who have been performing together since 2017. Joining Mary and Devin on stage is the wonderful Alex Wash, dueling pianist extraordinaire with nearly two decades of experience in the business. Here’s how it works: you request the songs, and our pianists will perform them on the spot, complete with clever quips, playful banter, and massive sing-alongs. Think of it as a live concert where the audience chooses the entire setlist in real time, with extra holiday magic thrown in! From Christmas classics to seasonal favorites, Billy Joel to Beyoncé, Mariah Carey to Bing Crosby, and everything in between, no genre is off-limits! Guests can also include a tip with their requests to move songs up in the queue, adding a fun, playfully competitive twist to the night. Expect an evening full of festive fun and joyful chaos, with singing, clapping, dancing, laughter, and plenty of surprises along the way! Throughout the show, our musicians may invite audience members up front or on stage for lighthearted contests, singalongs, and special celebrations. Whether you're gathering with friends, planning a holiday outing, or simply looking for a fun night out, this is all about bringing people together through music, laughter, and unforgettable memories. We're glad to offer seated general admission, along with the option to reserve a four-person table up front if you want to scale up the fun! Seating is limited, and this special holiday show is expected to sell out—grab your tickets early to guarantee your spot!

events.title: Monthly Honky Tonk Night w/ Danny & the Do-Overs!
events.description: Welcome to the West Art Honky Tonk: an evening of free-wheelin' top-shelf honky-tonk at West Art! Danny Mulligan and The Do-Overs want to see YOU on the dance floor. Drawing on classic honky tonk sounds as their foundation, they've got plenty of original music, with a few inspired covers sprinkled in for good measure. Come ready- this music is best enjoyed with scootin' boots! Grab a friend, pick up your dancing shoes, and we'll see ya there! Note: Join us at 6:45 for a pre-show dance lesson! Music is at 7:30! What to expect at the show: >> Doors will open at 6:45 for the dance lesson. The music will start at 7:30. >> Tickets are $15 in advance and at the door! As always, we’re proud to present an all-ages event! Come hang! >> Parking is available on the street around F&M College. We suggest finding a spot on the park side of Buchanan Ave, Race Ave, or College Ave (North of Buchanan). Thank you for helping us be good neighbors! >> Format: This show will be mostly standing, with plenty of room available for dancing. There are some seats available as needed. Our space is ADA accessible, and we will do our best to accommodate any specific needs. >>The Art Bar is open daily from 7 am to 10 pm with a full espresso menu, beer, wine, cocktails, N/A drinks, and tasty bites from local bakeries. Come settle in before the show, and linger after for a nightcap! >> Please note that all ticket sales are final. Tickets purchased using digital payment methods include a small service fee. Cash purchases at the door are not subject to this fee. Thank you for supporting great music!

events.title: West Art and WXPN Welcome Shovels & Rope: Bare Bones
events.description: West Art is thrilled to welcome Shovels & Rope to Lancaster! The Charleston-based duo of Cary Ann Hearst and Michael Trent has spent the better part of two decades building a massive reputation for their raw and rootsy blend of folk, rock, and Americana! Fueled by powerful harmonies and undeniable chemistry, Shovels & Rope are bringing an evening of unforgettable stories, songs, and moments, and we want you to be there! Tickets are going to move fast, and we fully expect this show to sell out!

events.title: West Art and WXPN Welcome Angela Autumn and Florry!
events.description: What does a porch-swing folk singer and a seven-piece cosmic country collective have in common? A lot more than you'd think. Pennsylvania's Angela Autumn and Florry each draw from the rich traditions of American folk and country music, but neither is interested in simply retelling old tales of the past. Angela Autumn's thoughtful songwriting combines warm melodies with deeply personal storytelling, while Florry transforms twang, indie rock, and psychedelic country into a freewheeling experience that's earned them a devoted following. Together, these two are bringing an evening full of intimate moments, sprawling jams, and modern Americana in a different light. Whether you're a long-term fan, or just hearing their names for the first time, this isn't a show you want to miss, so grab your denim (and maybe your dads old cowboy hat), and join us.

events.title: West Art Presents: An Evening with Elizabeth Cook!
events.description: West Art is thrilled to welcome Nashville-based singer-songwriter Elizabeth Cook to Lancaster! With her new album, Great Television!, Cook shines a light on the overlooked stories, untold histories, and human experiences that shape the American narrative. By blending her sharp perspective with heartfelt storytelling, Cook brings a fresh lens to the lives that are too often left out of the spotlight. And now, she's bringing those stories to The Sanctuary. Join us for this special evening with Elizabeth Cook!

This will be the first live performance of the new record in its entirety, so don’t miss it!

events.title: Watercolor Club with Jo Davis
events.description: A low-pressure, high-play painting hour. This is not a still life class—it’s about painting from within. Come as you are, grab your favorite supplies, and explore color, gesture, and mood. Jo offers simple prompts and intuitive guidance to help you loosen up and discover your own abstract style—no experience needed! Join us in the Art Bar on Fridays from 3:00-4:00 pm! This is an all-ages class! Cost: $15 - Payment is due to the instructor at the beginning of class! What to expect: Short warm-ups to get out of your head Guided prompts for expressive, intuitive painting Tips on color, composition, and letting go of “perfect” A relaxed studio vibe—drop in and make at your own pace What to bring: Your favorite painting supplies, or use what Jo has on hand Clothes you don’t mind getting paint on Optional: newsprint pad or sketchbook for warm-ups About Jo Davis: Jo is an artist and facilitator who loves helping people reconnect with creativity through process-driven play. Her classes focus on curiosity, color, and finding your own visual rhythm. Learn more at www.jodavis.art

events.title: Old Time Jam
events.description: We’re excited to introduce a weekly Old Time Jam right here in the West Art Coffee⚡Bar, led by the one and only Danny Mulligan! Join us on Tuesday from 6:30-9:30 pm to play along, or just to listen! We welcome acoustic instruments, but please no drums or amplifiers. We’ve got a tasty menu of coffee drinks, tea, beer, wine & cocktails to enjoy along with the music. Looking forward to a good old time community jam- hope you’ll join us!
